children: This is the wave structure subpage for Pre-MEGA Modes. It contains its every past wave layout.

These are the waves for all modes prior to the MEGA Update (13th of October 2019). This details the wave structure just before it was changed in the MEGA Update (with the last update of the structure being on the 15th of August 2019).
All modes followed the same structure, with the difficulty only defining when the game would end. Easy mode would end on wave 35 (
), Normal mode would end on wave 50 (
), Hard mode would end on wave 60 (
) and Insane mode would end on wave 68 (all the waves).
Prior to the 5th of August 2019, there were no difficulties to choose from (only map difficulties based on how hard the map was). This meant all rounds went to wave 56 (the last wave at the time).
